description: Variationof conditions 2 and removal of condition 4 of planning permission dated 9th January 2025 (RN 23/08767/FULL) for the amalgamation of two self-contained flats into 1 X 3 bed flat and erection of infill extension on upper ground floor level. NAMELY, condition 4, is not considered appropriate or technically feasible to implement. Whilst it is acknowledged that a green roof can offer benefits in terms of biodiversity enhancement, its implementation in this instance would result in disproportionate technical and design challenges. This is due to the limited size of the roof, combined with the regulatory requirements for a gravel margin (to provide fire resistance around the green roof) and the inclusion of an access hatch for maintenance. Together, these constraints would significantly reduce the usable area for a green roof, making its installation impractical in this instance, and would not be conducive to achieving the desired biodiversity gain anticipated. Moreover, we do not believe this sub-standard green roof would achieve the highest standards of design quality or aid  in  achieving higher significance to the conservation area, and we  therefore considered it appropriate to omit the biodiverse roof from the proposal.
